customManagers.description: The canonical-guard checkout in ci.yml pins go-kure/.github by SHA in `ref:`, invisible to the github-actions manager. Without this the vendored guard is byte-compared against a stale revision (go-kure/kure#689).

packageRules.description: Regenerate docs/compatibility.md on the bot's own branch after any gomod or mise bump — the committed matrix is generated from versions.yaml + go.mod, and CI's validate job fails on drift (sync-versions.sh check). Dependabot could not run this step, which left its PRs permanently red (#665, #667). The script is a no-op when nothing derived changes, so matching both managers is safe. go.mod is included because generate also rewrites its `// Current pin:` comment from the k8s.io/api replace directive.

Fold the go-kure/.github ref: customManager dependency into the same group as the github-actions uses: bump (shared.json's own github-actions group only matches matchManagers: ["github-actions"]), and re-vendor scripts/check-forbidden-terms.sh whenever it moves.

Flux minors are capped at the current series, preserving the intent of the retired Dependabot ignore rules: a fluxcd minor moves supported_range and the API surface together (see versions.yaml notes) and must be a deliberate coordinated upgrade, not a bot proposal. Dashboard-gated rather than disabled so the pending series stays visible. Majors are already gated org-wide by the shared preset.
